Source: https://codeload.github.com/knik0/faad2/zip/refs/tags/FAAD2_2_7
Archive SHA-256: c0ea38f8bdeff2e8e5d436982cfd8235b24ea4db31d2f9087a6c33dcc9b9d440
Tag: FAAD2_2_7
Scope: decoder C sources, headers, original notices.
Local modifications:
- common.h: rename the MSVC inline lrintf helper to faad_lrintf to avoid a
  collision with the modern compiler's intrinsic. Keep the original x87 body.
- mdct.c, syntax.c: convert legacy-encoded comments to UTF-8.
Build: x86, floating-point output, /O2 /fp:precise /arch:SSE2.
The wrapper derives original NeAACDecInit2's additional frame-length result
from AudioSpecificConfig, without changing the public upstream decoder ABI.
